basic_details.job_title: GPSC Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Gujarat Public Service Commission (GPSC) has invited online applications for 4 posts of Assistant Engineer (Electrical), Class-II (Advertisement No. 64/2026-27) under Sports Authority of Gujarat. The pay is Pay scale Rs. 9300-34800, Grade Pay 4600, Entry pay 44900, Level-8. The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical) or Technology (Electrical). Applications are accepted on gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in from 6 November 2026, 13:00 hours to 20 November 2026, 23:59 hours.

application_fee.general_fee: Rs. 100 + applicable postal charges (paid by challan at a post office) or Rs. 100 + applicable service charges (online)
application_fee.details: The fee is not refundable under any circumstances. If a candidate applies more than once, the last confirmed application with fee is considered for unreserved candidates.

age_limit.details: The candidate must be not more than 35 years of age. Age is counted on the last date of online application.

Basic knowledge of computer application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules 1967. Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. | Candidates must hold the qualification from a recognised university or institution. A certificate given by a college principal is not accepted in place of the marksheets and degree certificate. Where the university shows no percentage on the marksheet, the candidate must give the formula for calculating it. A degree or experience from a foreign university needs proof of its validity or equivalency in India, within the time limit.

how_to_apply: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) first. OTR is mandatory, but registering alone does not count as an online application.
Apply online at gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in between 6 November 2026, 13:00 hours and 20 November 2026, 23:59 hours.
Read the advertisement number (64/2026-27) and the post name carefully before applying.
Pay the fee if you are a candidate who must pay one, online or by post office challan.
Confirm the application only after checking all details filled in.
Use the "Edit" option to correct mistakes until the last date and time. Do not submit a new application.

The procedure for applying and paying the fee is shown at https://gpsc.gujarat.gov.in/HowtoApplyPay. Do not send a physical copy of the application or any documents to the Commission. Documents are uploaded online later, only by candidates eligible for scrutiny.
Documents named in the notice (to be kept ready; uploaded on gpsc-iass.gujarat.gov.in when the Commission asks):
Marksheets of all years/semesters and degree certificates, self-attested.
SSC certificate as proof of date of birth.
Caste, non-creamy layer (NCL) or EWS certificate, in the prescribed format, for reserved category candidates.
Disability certificate in Form V, VI or VII under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017, for disabled candidates.

No Objection Certificate of the appointing authority for candidates serving with the Central Government, another state government, local self-government institutions, cooperative bodies or an Agricultural Produce Market Committee.
Affidavit of not having remarried, for widow candidates.

content_sections.heading: About GPSC
content_sections.text: The Gujarat Public Service Commission is located at Sector 10-A, Near Chh-3 Circle, Chh Road, Gandhinagar - 382010. This notice is issued by its R-8 Branch and is signed by Gaurav Pandya, Joint Secretary. Candidates selected for this post will be employees/officers of Sports Authority of Gujarat and will not be considered employees/officers of the Government of Gujarat.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The women's columns show the vacancies reserved for women out of the category-wise posts. If no woman candidate is available for a post reserved for women, it may be allotted to a male candidate of the same category. Candidates with disability may apply only if they have one of the disabilities listed in the notice: Group B (deaf, hard of hearing), Group C (locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and similar) and Group D&E (autism, specific learning disability, mental illness and multiple disabilities). The posts reserved for each group are 00.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical) or Technology (Electrical) from a university established or incorporated by or under a Central or State Act in India, or any other educational institution recognised as such or declared a deemed university under section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956. Basic knowledge of computer application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules 1967. Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. Candidates must hold the qualification from a recognised university or institution. A certificate given by a college principal is not accepted in place of the marksheets and degree certificate. Where the university shows no percentage on the marksheet, the candidate must give the formula for calculating it. A degree or experience from a foreign university needs proof of its validity or equivalency in India, within the time limit. The candidate must be not more than 35 years of age. Age is counted on the last date of online application. Gujarat Government employees who have served for six consecutive months, permanent or temporary, and whose first appointment was within the age limit of the advertised post, get the following. The upper age limit does not apply if experience is sought as a qualification. It also does not apply to an employee appointed to an engineering, medical, agricultural or veterinary degree or diploma post, when experience is not sought. Where experience is not sought, an employee in a cadre from which promotion is possible gets the length of service rendered or a maximum of five years, whichever is less. Employees and officers of the Gujarat Maritime Board get no relaxation where experience is not prescribed. Reserved category candidates who apply for unreserved posts do not get any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GPSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The procedure for applying and paying the fee is shown at https://gpsc.gujarat.gov.in/HowtoApplyPay . Do not send a physical copy of the application or any documents to the Commission. Documents are uploaded online later, only by candidates eligible for scrutiny. Documents named in the notice (to be kept ready; uploaded on gpsc-iass.gujarat.gov.in when the Commission asks): Marksheets of all years/semesters and degree certificates, self-attested. SSC certificate as proof of date of birth. Caste, non-creamy layer (NCL) or EWS certificate, in the prescribed format, for reserved category candidates. Discharge book copy for ex-servicemen. Disability certificate in Form V, VI or VII under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017, for disabled candidates. No Objection Certificate of the appointing authority for candidates serving with the Central Government, another state government, local self-government institutions, cooperative bodies or an Agricultural Produce Market Committee. Affidavit of not having remarried, for widow candidates.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by a preliminary test followed by an interview. Candidates are called for interview after scrutiny of applications, in order of preliminary test merit. The medium is Gujarati unless the Commission decides otherwise. The test is generally held at Gandhinagar/Ahmedabad, and candidates attend at their own expense. A candidate scoring less than 15% in the preliminary test is not eligible for the interview. A Consent Form and Consent Deposit may be taken for appearing in the exam, with detailed instructions published later. The syllabus is on gpsc.gujarat.gov.in and gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in. For 4 or more vacancies, the number of candidates called for interview is 3 times the number of vacancies or 20, whichever is higher. The interview carries 100 marks. Final selection is on 50% weight of the preliminary test marks (out of 300) and 50% weight of the interview marks (out of 100): preliminary marks x 50/300 plus interview marks x 50/100. The final result will be published within 10 working days after the interview is completed.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GPSC Advt. 64/2026-27?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies for Assistant Engineer (Electrical), Class-II: 3 General and 1 SEBC, of which 1 General post is reserved for women.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of online application is 20 November 2026, up to 23:59 hours. Applications opened on 6 November 2026 at 13:00 hours.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assistant Engineer (Electrical)?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical) or Technology (Electrical) from a recognised university or institution, basic computer knowledge as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules 1967, and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The candidate must be not more than 35 years of age on the last date of online application. Relaxation of up to 45 years maximum applies to listed categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for this post?
faq.answer: The pay is Pay scale Rs. 9300-34800/-, Grade Pay-4600, Entry pay-44900/-, Level-8.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General (Unreserved) candidates pay Rs. 100 plus applicable postal charges by post office challan, or Rs. 100 plus applicable service charges online. Reserved categories of Gujarat, EWS of Gujarat, ex-servicemen and disabled candidates pay no fee. The fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for GPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Complete One Time Registration (OTR), then apply online at gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in before the last date. Do not send any hard copy of the application to the Commission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by a preliminary test of 300 marks and an interview of 100 marks. Final selection uses 50% weight for each. A score below 15% in the preliminary test makes a candidate ineligible for interview.

faq.question: Q9. Will selected candidates be Government of Gujarat employees?
faq.answer: No. Selected candidates will be employees/officers of Sports Authority of Gujarat and will not be considered employees/officers of the Government of Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. Can I edit my application after submitting it?
faq.answer: Yes, until the last date and time. Use the "Edit" option instead of submitting a new application. No correction is accepted after the advertisement closes.
